action: 2 numbers (right leg, left leg), clipped to -1..1; leg speed in the upright direction = (a + 1) / 2 x this motor's TOP speed (-1 = stopped, +1 = top speed). Training drew each robot's top speed from top_speed_rpm_range; on a real motor the robot side picks one top speed inside that range (config.POLICY_TOP_RPM). In the simulator's joint coordinates the upright direction is a NEGATIVE speed.
observation_layout: gravity direction in the body frame (unit vector; (0,0,-1) when level)
body angular velocity in the body frame, rad/s
sin, cos of (heading - start heading), CCW from above positive
sin(q_right), sin(q_left), cos(q_right), cos(q_left); q = joint angle, 0 = leg pointing forward (+Y)
(leg angle now - leg angle at the last decision) / decision_dt_s, / leg_speed_norm_rpm in rad/s (the encoder average)
body_axes: x = robot's right, y = robot's front (walking direction), z = up
